<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-04-0422-28-03" status="unreviewed">dang po ni <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha 1</rs> na re yid ches pa'i bsal pa'i <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> rgol bas dam bcas pa gang zhig phyir rgol gyis gzhi gzhan la zhugs pa'i tshad ma dang 'gal bas gnod par byed pa yin lo | mtshan gzhi dang de
               <lb n="69a7"/>brjod pa ni brtsod gzhi rgyal po'i na mo la nga'i ma mo gsham yi do zhes dam bcas pa na bus ldan gyi ldog pa yang bsal bya'i dam bca' yi na la | nus med kyi ldog pa yang bsal bya'i dam bca' min te 2 ka la 'dod la grub bsal med pa tshang ba'i phyir des na nus ldan dang nus med 2 ka yin pa'i sgrub phyogs kyi phung 2 du dam bcas pa de bsal bya yin
               <lb n="69a8"/>la sel byed ni gzhi gzhan 2ri za'i bu mong paso pa'i sting du du skyed pa'i nbus ldan du yong su chod pa na nus med rnam bcad la khegs pas spyir shes bya la 2 ka yin pa'i sgrub phyogs kyi phung 3 khegs pa na brtsod gzhi rgyal rigs bu mo'i steng du sgrub phyogs kyi phung 3 du dam bcas pa la sel ba yin | yang bu skyed pa'i nus med la rtog pa myongs pa'i rang rigs nus
               <lb n="69a9"/>med kyi rnam pa tsam 1 grub pa na bus ldan gyi rnam pa shugs la khegs pas lung 3 du dam bcas pa la se yo gsung | 'di dgag pa la 2 te | rigs pas mi 'thad pa dang | 'dung dang 'gal ba'o |</seg></TEI>
